title: Before a card is added, its repayment reads as spending
found: AMEWX PAYMENT 37004 has no transfer word, so with no card in the Kitty it books as a purchase: three months of chapter 1 spending are overstated by the card repayment. Once the card is held the pair forms by amount.
want: A line naming a card product reads as an unknown-account transfer until the card is held, with a next step to add it. The public dictionary could carry the parody card names; a real card's name has the same shape.
landing: the dictionary, or one small base change
